about_the_game:
Letherfall, June 27, 1998.
A child is found on the shores of a lake. His eyes wide with terror, his body frozen with fear and cold.
Not far from him, dozens of lifeless bodies: Dylan is the only survivor.
The police investigate, secret services intervene, but it’s all in vain — the truth lies buried with the corpses and within the twisted corners of young Dylan’s mind.

Manhattan, 2018
Dylan still remembers nothing of that tragic night, but terrible nightmares begin to consume his mind.
Relentless. Violent.
A voice haunts him in his sleep. Just one sentence, repeated over and over:
"Come back to Letherfall."
It sounds like his sister Janie — whose body was the only one never found.

Driven by a dark impulse and the guidance of his therapist, Dylan returns to the now-abandoned village. Letherfall is rotten, decayed, silent… but it is not empty.
Something is there. Something watching. Something that remembers.

Explore a disturbing and decaying environment, through distorted memories, inhuman presences, and unspeakable horrors.
Survive, uncover the truth — or lose your mind trying.

Letherfall is waiting for you.
And this time… no one gets out.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: violence, blood and gore, disturbing imagery, cult-related themes, psychological horror, and references to suicide.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • VR Support: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • VR Support: No

short_description: Letherfall is a first-person horror video game with Lovecraftian elements: the player must make their way through monstrous entities and intricate puzzles while exploring the abandoned village of Letherfall. Some nightmares don’t fade. They’re just waiting for you to open the wrong door.
supported_languages:
English*, Italian
*languages with full audio support
